title: Sami shaman's Amanita muscaria winter-solstice ritual

tellings.quote: And then this shaman or this healer would travel with reindeer to collect these mushrooms and he would dry it over a fireplace.

plain: Tero Isokauppila, a Finnish mushroom entrepreneur, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about an old winter-solstice custom of the Sami, the reindeer-herding people of Lapland in the far north of Europe. He says a shaman or healer would travel with reindeer to collect Amanita muscaria, a red-and-white mushroom that alters the mind, and dry it over a fireplace. He tells it to show how deep the link between people and these mushrooms runs.
